title_en: Chinese History (1/20): The Legend of the Yellow Emperor
note_en: Phrases like 据传说 ("according to legend"), 相传 ("it has been handed down that") and 据说 ("it is said") open a sentence to signal that what follows comes from myth or oral tradition, not proven fact: 相传在他统治的时期，人们学会了种植五谷. English tends to scatter such hedges ("supposedly," "the story goes"), but Chinese puts them up front, and history writing uses them constantly to keep a polite distance from the claim.
